title: Reorganize documentation: separate plugins from components, add architecture guides
body:
Documentation had plugin components (calendar-view, chatbot, timeline) incorrectly documented in the basic components section, and was missing foundational architecture documentation.

## Changes

### Documentation Structure
- **Removed** `calendar-view.mdx`, `chatbot.mdx`, `timeline.mdx` from `content/docs/components/complex/`
  - These belong to plugin packages and are already documented in `content/docs/plugins/`
- **Added** missing plugin menu entries: `plugin-dashboard`, `plugin-form`, `plugin-grid`, `plugin-view`
  - All 15 plugin packages now have menu entries in `plugins/meta.json`

### New Architecture Documentation
- **Created** `content/docs/guide/architecture.md` (10KB)
  - Package structure and monorepo topology
  - Schema rendering pipeline
  - Registry pattern (Component + Field)
  - Expression engine
  - Styling constraints (Tailwind/CVA only)
  
- **Created** `content/docs/guide/layout.md` (11KB)
  - AppShell, Page, PageHeader, SidebarNav components
  - Layout patterns and responsive behavior

- **Updated** `guide/meta.json` to include `architecture`, `layout`, `fields` (existed but was orphaned)

## Result

Documentation now clearly separates plugins from basic components, all packages have menu entries, and developers have comprehensive guides for understanding the platform architecture and layout system.
